title: The Bone Pile
text: A pile of bones higher than a man lies outside a cave, picked clean and cracked for the marrow. Deer, horse and bear lie among them, along with some that wore boots. The quarry eats well, and it is not afraid of being found.

options.label: The wisest reads what it eats, hoping to learn what it fears.

outcomes.text: Hunters, mostly; a great many hunters. It is not afraid of you at all.

options.label: Use its own bones as bait, and draw it out to defend its larder.

outcomes.text: It comes roaring to defend its larder, bigger than the bones made it seem.

options.label: Search the bones for what the dead hunters carried. They will not mind.

outcomes.text: You pry a good knife from a dead hand. Then you feel the quarry's breath, hot and wet, on your neck.
